meta_description: Greg Hinchliffe Plastering in Sheffield offers expert plastering, rendering and skimming. Free quotes, reliable local craftsman. Call 07817 491302.
hero_subhead: Plastering done right first time. From new builds to renovation work, we deliver pristine finishes on time, every time.
services_subhead: We handle everything from small repairs to large-scale rendering and commercial projects, always delivering a professional finish.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Skim coating, boarding and jointing for walls and ceilings. We create smooth, paint-ready surfaces that transform your interiors.

services.title: Rendering & External Work
services.desc: Durable external renders, pebbledash and cement finishes. Protects your property whilst enhancing curb appeal.

services.title: Artex Removal
services.desc: Safe removal and replacement of textured ceilings. We leave you with a clean, modern finish ready for decoration.

services.title: Patch Repairs
services.desc: Quick fixes for cracks, holes and damaged plaster. Blended seamlessly to match your existing surfaces.

services.title: New Build Plastering
services.desc: Full plastering packages for new properties and extensions. On-schedule delivery with quality checked at every stage.

services.title: Commercial Projects
services.desc: Large-scale plastering for retail, office and industrial spaces. Minimal disruption, professional teams, guaranteed timelines.

about_pullquote: I built this business on doing the job right, first time, every time.
about_para_1: Greg Hinchliffe has been plastering across Sheffield and South Yorkshire for over 15 years. From Victorian terraces to modern new builds, he's tackled every job with the same meticulous approach and attention to detail. His reputation is built on showing up on time, finishing on schedule, and leaving your property spotless.
about_para_2: Customers return to Greg because he treats every project — whether a small patch repair or a full house renovation — with equal professionalism. He sources quality materials, works cleanly, and guarantees his finish. A family man based in Penistone, he knows the Sheffield area inside out and takes pride in being the plasterer neighbours recommend.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Greg

reviews.text: Greg came out to quote for our kitchen diner and did a brilliant job plastering the new partition wall. He was tidy, worked quickly, and the finish was perfect. We've already recommended him to two neighbours. Great value too.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with water damage to the bedroom ceiling. Greg assessed it properly, explained what needed doing, and had it replastered and ready for painting within three days. Professional from start to finish.
reviews.author: Sarah C.

reviews.text: Needed artex removal and new skim coat throughout the hall and landing. Greg was efficient, kept mess to a minimum, and the results look fantastic. No hesitation recommending him to anyone in the area.
reviews.author: David P.
